messages:
jen: FYI kicking off TeraHealth POC perf run now. Goal: validate 95th tail < 220ms for conversational workload with KMS enabled and 1:4 embed:gen mix. Need queue sizing + backpressure plan.
samir: ack. can you paste the target QPS profile?
jen: target sustained 120 qps, 30 qps spikes (30s every 5m). 99th we're okay to be higher but 95th must be steady.
ellie: do we have the model variant pinned? quantized int8 on gpu-a100?
jen: sales requested rtm-large-quant (v2) — we should test both int8 and fp16 fallback.
kai: adding ops: we should run with and without prefix caching to see cost/latency tradeoffs. suggestion: run 10m baseline then 2m spike, repeat 5x.
samir: plan: 3 workers hitting dedicated pool, steady-state open connections tuned to 500ms idle. queueing model: max inflight 256 per worker, reject after queue depth 1k with 429. Will monitor queue latency.
jen: sounds good. can we capture per-token latency and token counts for cost math? need that for pricing ask to TeraHealth.
ellie: yes. we'll send per-request token_count and server_side token_emit_time in logs. use this payload:
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model":"rtm-large-quant:v2",
  "input":"<prompt>",
  "stream":false
}
```
samir: deploy-bot: rolling deploy started to perf-branch -> staging (hash b7f3).
deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: perf-branch @ staging in 64s. :white_check_mark:
jen: security note from TeraHealth Sec: their questionnaire requires KMS latency budget in ms for each provenance call. we need to show worst-case key wrap latency.
kai: ops: can you run a KMS latency microbench against our KMS mock + real cloud KMS? we should capture p95/p99 and include in the report.
samir: will run two passes (mock + aws-kms-prod) and attach numbers. expected added latency ~6-12ms p95 on our env, but need confirm under load.
jen: pricing question from procurement: if they move to Dedicated with reserved capacity, what's the expected delta vs hosted for this workload? we need per-1000-token cost estimate for our suggested config.
ellie: rough calc: with batching + prefix cache enabled we expect ~35% token cost reduction vs naive fp16 hosting. I'll compute numbers after the run.
kai: ops note: we should also test packet loss / degraded network — small NAT flaps can amplify tail. propose 1% packet loss run.
samir: adding that. schedule: baseline 10m, 5x spike, 1% packet loss run, 2x KMS microbench. I can start in ~30m.
jen: thanks — I'll loop in sales leadership and TeraHealth. attaching run checklist and quick ops commands for the POC.
jen: checklist snippet:
```
- pin model version to rtm-large-quant:v2
- enable token metrics header X-Token-Count
- start observability stream to perf-bucket (retention 7d)
- run load profile: 120qps steady, 30qps spike 30s every 5m, 1% loss scenario
- capture KMS p95/p99 (mock + cloud)
- produce CSV with qps, p50/p95/p99 latency, token_count, fail-rate, cost-estimate
```
kai: I added a brief runbook to the ticket. tagging @jen for the pricing ask so finance can chime.
jen: ok thanks team. will reconvene after initial run with numbers and a short writeup for TeraHealth (they asked for a <48h turnaround). :v:
